battle.name: 第二次義衣戰爭
battle.theater: 衣索比亞北部提格雷戰線
battle.brief: 第二次義衣戰爭於1935年10月爆發，是中文維基「戰爭列表」所列的義大利王國與衣索比亞帝國之間衝突。交戰期間，衣索比亞軍隊曾裝備惠氏步槍（Winchester Model 1873），此型步槍是當時常見的槓桿式連發步槍之一，並與栓動步槍共同用於步兵部隊的日常作戰。

kit.name: 惠氏步槍
kit.history: 惠氏步槍曾為美國陸軍步兵制式連發步槍，屬步兵輕武器體系，作為步兵個人配發的標準槍械，並曾被衣索比亞等國軍隊採用。

countries: 第二次義埃戰爭於1935年10月3日在厄立特里亞與衣索比亞邊境開打。交戰一方是義大利王國，以及駐厄立特里亞與義屬索馬里的殖民軍；另一方是哈伊萊·塞拉西一世統治的衣索比亞帝國。義大利軍北線由埃米利奧·德·博諾指揮，使用王國野戰部隊、殖民步兵與隨軍航空兵；南線由魯道爾福·格拉齊亞尼率領，自摩加迪沙方向進入奧加登。衣索比亞軍隊則由中央王軍直接指揮，下轄王家近衛軍、基爾特·伊爾卡先鋒軍和各地軍區部隊。兩軍沿厄立特里亞至亞的斯亞貝巴、摩加迪沙至內格萊兩條相隔逾千公里的補給線展開，地形、缺水與道路修復速度從一開始就決定了推進節奏。
countriesEn: The Second Italo-Ethiopian War opened on 3 October 1935 across the frontier between Italian Eritrea and the Ethiopian Empire. One belligerent was the Kingdom of Italy, acting through its forces in Eritrea and Italian Somaliland; the other was Haile Selassie I’s Ethiopian Empire. Emilio De Bono commanded the Italian northern axis with Royal Army troops, colonial infantry and attached aviation. Rodolfo Graziani led the southern force from the Mogadishu direction into the Ogaden. Ethiopian forces came under the central imperial command of the emperor, with the Royal Guard, the Kilte-Irqa vanguard formations and regional military districts forming the main components. The campaign unfolded along two supply routes more than a thousand kilometres apart, running from Eritrea toward Addis Ababa and from Mogadishu toward Negele. Terrain, water scarcity and the rate at which roads could be repaired therefore shaped the pace of operations from the outset.
people: 德·博諾在十月初率北線部隊越境，北面與塞拉西交鋒的是拉斯·塞尤姆，其所部在梅克萊方向承受飛機與火砲壓力後，奉命逐步後撤。拉斯·伊姆魯接掌基爾特·伊爾卡先鋒軍，主張追擊退往南方的義大利軍；皇帝則把中央兵力集中起來，親赴前線指揮。11月18日，德·博諾被召回本土，彼得羅·巴多利奧接掌北線及最高戰術指揮。他把砲兵、汽車和飛機集中於少數主要道路，要求縮短行軍縱隊，再以火砲掩護裝甲車隊推進。格拉齊亞尼在南路保有獨立指揮權，進入內格萊後因燃料、糧食和飲水難以供應而停止推進。塞拉西在德加·羅巴發動反攻時，各軍彼此距離過遠，無法同步作戰；拉斯·伊姆魯在阿姆巴·阿拉吉遭封鎖時，拉斯·德斯塔所部與王家近衛軍共同掩護皇帝退出德布雷·利巴諾斯。這些指揮關係與補給問題貫穿了兩軍由進攻、失速、反攻到占領首都的全過程。
peopleEn: De Bono crossed the northern frontier in early October. Ras Seyoum commanded the Ethiopian forces facing the Italians around Mekelle and withdrew south in stages under artillery and air pressure. Ras Imru then took the Kilte-Irqa vanguard and pressed the retreating Italians, while the emperor concentrated the central army and went forward to direct operations. De Bono was recalled on 18 November, and Pietro Badoglio assumed command of the northern front and overall tactical direction. Badoglio concentrated guns, motor vehicles and aircraft on a limited number of major roads, shortened marching columns and used artillery to cover armoured movement. Graziani retained independent command in the south and halted at Negele because fuel, food and drinking water could not be moved forward reliably. When the emperor counterattacked at Daga Roba, his widely separated formations could not attack in concert. At Amba Alagi, Ras Imru’s force was surrounded and cut off, while troops under Ras Desta and the Royal Guard helped cover the emperor’s withdrawal toward Debre Libanos. These command relationships and logistical constraints remained decisive from the initial advance through the counteroffensive and the occupation of the capital.
kits: 義大利步兵主要使用7.65毫米卡爾卡諾M91步槍，Breda M35與Fiat-Revelli M35輕機槍則使用8毫米彈藥；野戰砲包括75/27野戰砲、105/25榴彈砲，輕型山地與馳載砲則有65/27。裝甲方面使用L3/35坦_SHA克車，航空主力為CR.32戰鬥機與SM.81轟炸機，公路後勤依靠Fiat 626等卡車，火砲仍以馬匹牽引，離開鋪裝道路後再由騾馬接運。衣索比亞軍隊使用馬丁尼－亨利Mk I至Mk IV、李－恩菲爾德、M1895毛瑟等步槍，Madsen M15輕機槍及舊式75毫米山砲則因來源不同而缺乏統一規格；其主要運輸依靠步行、騡馬和獸力車隊。義大利軍自身也必須分發7.65毫米與8毫米不同彈藥，並在前線維修大量汽車、坦克與航空引擎，裝備優勢始終受道路和維修能力制約。
kitsEn: Italian infantry principally carried the 7.65mm Carcano M91 rifle, while the Breda M35 and Fiat-Revelli M35 light machine guns used 8mm ammunition. Field and support artillery included the 75/27 field gun, 105/25 howitzer and 65/27 pack or mountain gun. L3/35 tankettes formed the armoured force, CR.32 fighters and SM.81 bombers provided the main air support, and trucks such as the Fiat 626 carried supplies along the roads. Artillery remained largely horse-drawn, with mule teams taking over beyond the paved routes. Ethiopian formations used Martini-Henry rifles from Mk I through Mk IV, Lee-Enfield and Mauser M1895 rifles, Madsen M15 light machine guns and older 75mm mountain guns. Their specifications varied according to source, and movement depended largely on marching, mule transport and animal-drawn vehicles. Even the Italian army had to distribute different 7.65mm and 8mm ammunition and maintain large numbers of vehicles, tanks and aircraft engines at the front, so its material advantage remained constrained by road conditions and repair capacity.
tactics: 10月3日，義大利軍在加拉巴特山口及翁布里河一帶以火砲準備、CR.32低空掃射和步兵縱隊展開突破，先後於10月21日占領阿克蘇姆，11月8日進入梅克萊。南線在10月11日占領多洛後沿摩加迪沙－內格萊道路推進；12月6日的根納萊攻勢受挫，但格拉齊亞尼仍於12月19日控制內格萊。北線方面，義大利軍在切連科於12月11日擋住衣索比亞先鋒；塞拉西集中兵力於1936年1月5日在德加·羅巴反攻，密集火砲和機槍射界切斷正面攻勢。2月5日的阿迪·澤門戰鬥中，衣索比亞部隊再度未能突破義大利陣線；2月17日阿姆巴·阿拉吉則因兩翼被封閉而崩解。義大利軍的戰術並非一味追求速度，而是先建立道路補給點，配置75/27與105/25火砲，以L3/35偵察和威嚇，再用_CR.32發現集中攻擊。衣索比亞軍隊常因道路崎嶇而分成互不接應的縱隊，攻勢一旦受阻，後方供應和傷員安置便迅速拉長。
tacticsEn: On 3 October the Italians attacked through the Gallabat Pass and the Ombre river sector, combining preparatory artillery, low-level strafing by CR.32 fighters and infantry columns. They occupied Axum on 21 October and entered Mekelle on 8 November. In the south, the force that had seized Dolo on 11 October advanced along the Mogadishu–Negele road. Its movement was checked at Genale on 6 December, but Graziani still controlled Negele by 19 December. On the northern front, the Italians stopped an Ethiopian advance at Chelenqo on 11 December. The emperor concentrated his army for a counterstroke at Daga Roba on 5 January 1936, but concentrated artillery and machine-gun fire cut the frontal attack. The attempt at Addi Zemen on 5 February again failed to break the Italian line, and at Amba Alagi on 17 February the Ethiopian formations were enveloped on both flanks. Italian tactics generally subordinated speed to logistics: road depots were established first, 75/27 and 105/25 guns were positioned, L3/35 tankettes reconnoitred and screened, and CR.32 aircraft located targets for concentrated fire. Ethiopian columns were often separated by difficult roads, and once an advance stalled, food, ammunition and medical evacuation lines stretched rapidly.
data: 後勤上最明確的資料是北線由馬薩瓦經阿戈達特至梅克萊的鐵路，以及梅克萊以南通往亞的斯亞貝巴的道路；從厄立特里亞邊境至首都的路程約六百公里。南線由摩加迪沙至內格萊的道路超過一千公里，義大利軍雖已推進至內格萊，後方仍須維持很長的車隊與護送線。雨季結束後道路可以通行，乾季則迅速增加井站、飲水、飼料和車輛維修需求。義大利軍以阿戈達特、梅克萊等地為主要樞紐，把糧食、汽油和砲彈集中後再分送前線；離開主要道路的單位仍依賴騡馬和獸力。1936年，義大利在戰區投入的兵力以數十萬計，航空兵力達數百架，但真正能連續作戰的是接近道路補給點的分遣隊。國際聯盟於1935年11月19日對交戰雙方施行武器禁運，英法等國沒有派兵執行制裁，也沒有提供決定性的軍事干預。雙方公報對俘獲、繳獲和傷亡採用不同基準，因此沒有可核實的單一傷亡總數，任何精確傷亡數字都應視為估算而非定論。
dataEn: The clearest logistical facts concern the railway from Massawa through Agordat to Mekelle and the road continuing south toward Addis Ababa. The route from the Eritrean frontier to the Ethiopian capital was roughly six hundred kilometres. In the south, the road from Mogadishu to Negele exceeded one thousand kilometres, so even after Graziani’s troops reached Negele the Italians still had to maintain long convoy and escort lines. Roads were usable after the rains, but the dry season rapidly increased demand for wells, water, animal feed and vehicle maintenance. Italy used Agordat and Mekelle as major distribution centres, concentrating food, petrol and ammunition before sending them forward; units away from the main roads still relied on mule packs and animal transport. By 1936 Italy had committed forces numbering in the hundreds of thousands and hundreds of aircraft to the theatre, but only detachments close to road depots could sustain continuous operations. The League of Nations imposed an arms embargo on both belligerents on 19 November 1935. Britain, France and other members did not send troops to enforce sanctions or provide decisive military intervention. The two sides used different reporting standards for prisoners, captured equipment and casualties, so no single verified total exists; any precise casualty figure should be treated as an estimate rather than an established fact.
cause: 戰爭的根本原因是義大利在1896年第一次義埃戰爭失敗後，始終把衣索比亞視為不肯納入其殖民體系的主要對手。取得並長期控制衣索比亞，可以把厄立特里亞和義屬索馬里連成一體，也能改變紅海沿岸交通與亞的斯亞貝巴－吉布提鐵路的戰略位置。當時可證實的動因是殖民擴張與戰略利益，而不是一處已發現油田的爭奪。1934年12月瓦爾瓦勒一帶的邊境衝突及哨所傷亡事件，被義大利用來質疑1928年邊界仲裁的效力；實際上，德·博諾沒有等待新的裁決，也沒有把行動限制在邊界懲罰。他選擇雨季結束、道路可通行的10月開始進攻，並分別由厄立特里亞和索馬里方向作戰。塞拉西過去十年的軍隊整編、歐洲武器採購與中央權力集中，使義大利決策者把衣索比亞視為更難控制的對手；但直接開戰仍是義大利主動選擇的殖民征服行動，而非被迫防守邊界。
causeEn: The underlying cause was Italy’s persistent determination to incorporate Ethiopia into its colonial system after losing the First Italo-Ethiopian War in 1896. Possession of Ethiopia would connect Eritrea and Italian Somaliland and alter Italy’s strategic position along the Red Sea approaches and the Addis Ababa–Djibouti railway. The demonstrable motives at the time were colonial and strategic rather than competition over a newly discovered oilfield. Border clashes near Walwal in December 1934, including casualties among Italian and Ethiopian outposts, were used by Rome to question the authority of the 1928 boundary arbitration. De Bono did not actually await a new ruling and did not confine his operation to a limited border punishment. He opened the campaign in October, after the rains had made the roads passable, and attacked from both Eritrea and Somaliland. Haile Selassie’s military reorganization, foreign arms purchases and concentration of central authority during the previous decade made Ethiopia appear more difficult for Rome to control. Even so, the immediate decision to fight remained an Italian choice to carry out colonial conquest rather than a defensive response to an Ethiopian invasion.
impact: 阿姆巴·阿拉吉的封鎖之後，衣索比亞中央軍隊失去協同，馬利亞·德斯塔與拉斯·伊姆魯等指揮官各自帶隊撤退或被分割；巴多利奧隨即把義大利軍沿梅克萊－德西－亞的斯亞貝巴公路向南推進，3月1日占領德西，至5月初完成對首都的接管。5月19日至31日，殘存衣索比亞部隊在馬奇丘與羅貝一線伏擊義大利補給縱隊和裝甲支隊，使局部戰術進度受到影響，但未能扭轉首都失守。塞拉西於5月31日離開亞的斯亞貝巴，6月6日抵達吉布提，隨後進入流亡。南部與山區仍有成建制或零散武裝繼續作戰，義大利控制主要道路和城鎮，卻沒有同時消除各地抵抗。國際層面上，聯盟制裁缺乏執行力量，義大利仍能完成占領，collective security的信用受到直接損傷；衣索比亞案雖持續留在聯盟議程，卻沒有帶來足以扭轉戰局的軍事干預。
impactEn: After the encirclement at Amba Alagi, the Ethiopian central army lost cohesion. Senior commanders such as Ras Desta and Ras Imru led separated withdrawals or were isolated, while Badoglio moved his forces south along the Mekelle–Dessie–Addis Ababa road. Dessie fell on 1 March, and control of the capital was completed in early May. Between 19 and 31 May, surviving Ethiopian troops ambushed Italian supply columns and an armoured detachment in the Maychew and Robé sectors. These attacks disrupted local operations but did not reverse the loss of the capital. Haile Selassie left Addis Ababa on 31 May, reached Djibouti on 6 June and went into exile. Formed Ethiopian units and smaller organized bands continued fighting in the south and mountains, so Italian control of the main roads and towns did not amount to simultaneous elimination of every resistance area. Internationally, the League’s sanctions lacked enforcement, allowing Italy to complete the occupation and dealing collective security a direct blow. Ethiopia remained on the League’s agenda, but no measure produced military intervention capable of reversing the war.
result: 1936年5月9日，義大利國王維托里奧·埃馬努埃萊三世頒布法令，把衣索比亞併入義大利的非洲領地，並兼用衣索比亞皇帝頭銜。10月23日簽訂的《亞的斯亞貝巴條約》以承認衣索比亞主權的方式正式結束公開戰爭，同時把義大利在厄立特里亞、奧爾特雷朱巴及奧加登部分地區的權利和駐軍安排固定下來；四天後，義大利東非總督區正式成立，囊括厄立特里亞、義屬索馬里與被占領的衣索比亞。條約解決的是外交文件與主要戰線，沒有完成戰場清剿。流亡政府承認的武裝在山區繼續集結，1937年2月1日至3日的安巴·阿拉達姆戰鬥中，衣索比亞游擊隊擊退一支義大利縱隊。因而1935至1936年的戰爭在占領首都、解散中央軍和改變國際地位上已有明確結果，但在軍事控制與政治效忠上仍未完全結束，義大利取得的是廣大而需要長期守備的殖民占領區。
resultEn: On 9 May 1936, Victor Emmanuel III issued a decree incorporating Ethiopia into the Italian African possessions and assumed the imperial title of Ethiopia. The Treaty of Addis Ababa, signed on 23 October, formally ended the open war while recognizing Ethiopian sovereignty and fixing Italy’s territorial rights in Eritrea, Oltre Giuba and parts of the Ogaden, together with arrangements for Italian garrisons. Four days later, Italian East Africa was formally established by combining Eritrea, Italian Somaliland and occupied Ethiopia. The treaty settled the diplomatic document and the principal front lines, but it did not complete a battlefield clearing operation. Armed forces loyal to the government in exile continued to organize in the mountains, and on 1–3 February 1937 Ethiopian irregular forces defeated an Italian column at Amba Aradam. The war of 1935–1936 therefore produced a definite result in the occupation of the capital, the disruption of Ethiopia’s central army and a major shift in international position, but it did not end military resistance or eliminate the need to hold a broad colonial conquest. Italy obtained an extensive occupation zone that still required prolonged and costly defense.
